disposition_reason: The registered target is estrous/hormone modulation of dopamine and reward-history associations. The paper explicitly avoids calling the behavioral modulation better or worse because the optimized costs/benefits are unobserved. A greater dopamine contrast or smaller P value cannot surpass that finding; fitting a new predictor would change the task.

source_paper.title: Estrogen modulates reward prediction errors and reinforcement learning

evidence.locator: Results: Estrogen levels predict enhanced learning, final paragraph; Figures 2–3; Methods: Behavioral model
evidence.supports: Descriptive behavioral interpretation, dopamine stage contrasts and model-derived RPE associations.
Proestrus/diestrus comparisons; 500 ms dopamine AUC; post-violation exclusion and serum linkage.
Supplied BestFits, RPE regressions and gain/learning-rate simulations; these are not heldout model scores.
Separate figure deposits and process/visualization roles.
Figure-2 source archive identity; other figures require their own deposited inputs.

target.description: Estimate proestrus-versus-diestrus dopamine response differences and estradiol/RPE/reward-history associations.

dataset.description: Zenodo 16912311 for Figure 2; author README assigns 16912773 to Figure 3 and 16903822 to Figures 1/5/6. These are distinct deposits, not interchangeable inputs.

cohort.description: Retain the original figure-specific rat/session populations and their joins. The reviewed process files define rat lists and serum inputs, but complete cross-deposit inclusion parity has not been established.

split.description: These source stage contrasts and within-rat regressions do not define a heldout prediction competition. New longitudinal train/test partitions would be an extension.

inputs.description: Processed photometry/behavior structures, estrous stage and serum records; Figure 3 additionally loads supplied BestFits. Fitted parameters must not masquerade as newly predicted targets.

preprocessing.description: Preserve exclusion of post-violation trials, alignment and the 0.5-second AUC window. Stage definitions and source-specific baseline corrections must remain unchanged.

metric.description: Dopamine AUC contrasts and RPE/reward-history regression coefficients are biological estimands. AUC here means integrated fluorescence, not classifier ROC-AUC.

aggregation.description: Source summaries are rat-level stage contrasts with nested sessions/trials; serum and photometry cohorts remain distinct unless their joins are authenticated.

comparison.primary_metric: No ordered model-performance endpoint in the registered estrous/dopamine contrasts

published_baseline.description: The reported dopamine effects and their tests are findings to reproduce, not a score to maximize.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: An author process-file rerun can calibrate Figure 2/3 analysis. Supplied BestFits or the initial evaluator do not constitute a new predictive baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: Larger hormone effects or stronger significance cannot define scientific performance improvement for this estimand.

uncertainty.method: No improvement decision rule applies; any reproduction uncertainty retains rat/session hierarchy and nonrandomized stage interpretation.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Rat; repeated sessions and trials are nested.
uncertainty.rationale: The same rat observed at two stages is paired; sessions are not independent animals.

paper_win_requires: No paper win is admitted for the registered descriptive associations.
Preserve the biological estimands, population and exclusions; stronger RPE modulation or lower P values are not success.
A new heldout behavior/dopamine predictor must be separately registered and compared with a task-matched source baseline.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison has been verified; source-paper reproduction and same-task improvement are separate outcomes.

episode.improvement_loop: No active improvement loop for the registered hormonal association task.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freezing a regression implementation supports reproducibility but does not create ordered paper performance.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate Figure 2 contrasts only as calibration; Figure 3 refitting is not implied by supplied BestFits.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep published estimates, source reconstruction and any future longitudinal prediction extension distinct.

blocking_issues: The registered source question has no ordered algorithm-performance endpoint.
Full rat/session joins and native-export parity remain calibration gaps, not evidence of improvement eligibility.

legacy.notes: Preserve the initial evaluator for Figure 2 stage/AUC/serum calibration and all original Figure 3 provenance. It does not fit models or reproduce all paper results.
